An '''assault company''', otherwise known as a '''heavy weapons company''', was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
Assault companies were comprised of two [[assault platoon]]s, two [[line platoon]]s, along with command and support elements. The manpower of an assault company was between 152 to 170 [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] depending on the configuration of the individual assault platoons, with command/support elements bringing the number up to between 180 to 198 in total. Line platoons assigned to an assault company were equipped with [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blasters]].<ref name="ISB" />

Assault companies could be augmented by the addition of a further two [[assault platoon]]s, and two [[line platoon]]s.<ref name="ISB2" />
